intro: The Defias Brotherhood is a widespread criminal network of bandits, brigands, and assassins waging an underground insurgency against the Kingdom of Stormwind. Their origins are a mystery to most, and they have grown into violent outlaws terrorizing the southern farmlands. From a hidden redoubt, they aim to overthrow the corrupt House of Nobles and lay waste to the kingdom.
